name: kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky
attribution: Poly Haven (polyhaven.com) - CC0, attribution not required
notes: PRIMARY day sky. Deep blue sky with scattered fair-weather cumulus - the typical trade-wind sky over Poipu. Sun ~48 deg up in the photo. Pure sky (no ground).
blender_usage: Environment Texture (equirectangular) <- Mapping(Vector, rotation Z = radians(sun_azimuth_blender_deg - target_sun_azimuth_deg)) <- Texture Coordinate.Generated. Azimuths are atan2(y, x) in Blender world XY (counter-clockwise from +X). With the *_nosun file, add a Sun lamp (angle 0.53 deg) at the astronomically correct direction with strength = sun_strength_blender x world strength and colour = sun_color_rgb_norm (strength x colour reproduces the measured sun irradiance per channel, sun_irradiance_rgb).
